description: This file defines an interface for a dictionary (IDictionary) in the WPEFramework, including nested interfaces for notification and iteration, with methods for registration, unregistration, access, and modification of dictionary entries.

classes.name: IDictionary
classes.description: An interface providing access and modification operations on a dictionary with support for notifications and iteration.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a sink to observe changes in a specified namespace.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a sink from observing changes in a specified namespace.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a given namespace and key.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a value for a given namespace and key.

methods.name: Get (IIterator)
methods.description: Returns an iterator for a specified namespace.

methods.name: Modified
methods.description: Signals that a specific key within a namespace has been modified with a new value.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the initial position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the iterator is at a valid position.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Returns the current key pointed to by the iterator.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the current value pointed to by the iterator.

ctags.name: IDictionary
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL IDictionary : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/

ctags.name: IIterator
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL IIterator : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/

ctags.name: INotification
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL INotification : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
